About Railwheel

Ma'anshan Railwheel Industrial Technology Co., Ltd.

Railway components · China · Worldwide inquiries

A focused partner for railway component supply and export.

Ma'anshan Railwheel Industrial Technology Co., Ltd. is based in Ma'anshan City, Anhui Province, China. We support international buyers sourcing railway wheels, wheelsets, axles, bogie components, braking parts and related rolling-stock products.

Our work begins with understanding the application and defining the required item. We coordinate drawing-based inquiries, technical clarification, manufacturing or sourcing follow-up, inspection-document requirements and export arrangements against the scope agreed for each order.

For new-build and maintenance procurement, clear product identity matters. A complete wheelset, an individual wheel, a bearing adapter and an axle box require different technical inputs. We help organize those inputs before a quotation becomes a supply commitment.

Working with Railwheel

A defined route from inquiry to shipment.

Technical and commercial assumptions are clarified at each stage, not left for the receiving workshop to discover.

01 · Define

Application and drawings

Identify the component, revision, vehicle, mating interfaces, quantity and required delivery condition. List any missing technical inputs.

02 · Review

Scope and quotation

Confirm manufacturing or sourcing feasibility, required documentation, inspection scope, exclusions and declared deviations before order acceptance.

03 · Coordinate

Production and inspection

Follow the agreed scope and inspection plan. Keep part identity, applicable documents and any authorized dispositions connected.

04 · Deliver

Packing and export

Coordinate preservation, identification, packing lists and shipment communication for the agreed destination and commercial delivery terms.

On-site reference material

From component review to technical discussion.

Photographs selected from the company's workshop and business-visit materials.

Dimensional and interface review

Controlled drawings establish the measurement datums, critical profiles and mating interfaces. Agree the inspection method and reporting scope before production.

Clear technical communication

Document the requested supply boundary, drawing revision, inspection expectations and open questions so the quotation and purchase order use the same baseline.

Quality and technical evidence

Agree the acceptance basis before supply.

Depending on the component and contract, the required package may include material records, dimensional results, specified examinations, assembly records, marking evidence and conformity documentation.

Standards, editions and any required approvals must be identified for the actual project. A general product category or reference photograph is not evidence of certification, interchangeability or a particular production capacity.

Quality control and documentation →
Applications and markets

Supporting different rolling-stock requirements.

Our inquiry channels serve buyers working on freight wagons, passenger coaches, metro vehicles, locomotives, mining railways and industrial railway equipment. We distinguish new-build supply from maintenance replacement and component-only requests from complete assemblies.

Send the actual operating context and approved technical package so the requested supply can be reviewed against the correct requirements.
